items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: So my teacher was the top trumpet player in San Francisco. Dick Lawter... So Dick Lawter gave me a list of all the trumpet players in San Francisco... you want to study with you and no one else.

ctx.x: Do you think they would have denied you membership if you couldn’t play that well? Because I’ve heard a couple of stories from other musicians —

Well it all depends where you were. This is San Francisco Local 6. So I don’t know. I mean later on I think everybody had to audition in those times, and it was I think $50 to join the union and $9 a quarter or something you know. So my teacher was the top trumpet player in San Francisco. Dick Lawter and a first call guy. And so see that’s the smart thing to do. If you move to a city, I’ve told students this, if you want to go to New York or something, or wherever, find out who the number one call player is, and…
